rationale: The agent lagged champions by ~$19k due to rigid monoculture on Days 1-25 that locked out 2x-3x Town Shop Carrot contracts, a static $350 cash hurdle that stalled seed purchases during early cycles, and uncoordinated workforce harvest dispatch. We introduce earlier Town Shop crop diversification from Day 1, dynamic seed budgeting that funds planting whenever cash exceeds midnight payroll by $50+, tiered pacing for oracle sales starting at 15 shed items for peak prices (>=1.10x), and explicit town shop harvest capturing and early hand recruitment within farm execution.
